objects: one source with one or two increasing Station symbols
state_reads: source identity, timestamp and charge counters
compiled symbol membership and explicit P/T-box placement
state_writes: Station and child results delegate transitions to their canonical owners
costs: independently compiled Station retains its ordinary cost at any charge count
timing: continuous battlefield evaluation; children retain their ordinary timing
targets: children retain their complete independently compiled target schema
choices: existing private, optional, target, search, library-order and APNAP owners execute child choices
hidden_information: counters and characteristics are public; private child choices retain ordinary principal projection
apnap: ordinary trigger stacking and affected-player APNAP choices
layers: a P/T-bearing symbol adds creature in layer4
keywords and child membership participate in layer6
the fixed P/T box sets base values in layer7b
unconditional base values exclude the conditional P/T box
replacement_effects: Station counter production uses the existing replacement-aware transaction
copy: copied symbols use the copy own counters; current counters and derived animation are not copied
control_change: thresholds are source-relative; child controllers and subjects retain their existing ownership
zone_change: no power or toughness outside the battlefield; new incarnations lose old counters and copy identity
source_leaves: source-bound symbol effects cease for that incarnation

variants: one or two cumulative fixed thresholds
independently closed keyword, static, triggered and activated children
counter loss, copies, ability removal, private choices and replay

implementation.component: StationSymbolsSpec, StationSymbolsHandler, Station compiler context, existing static-component scopes and canonical layer/counter/choice owners
implementation.supported_slice: One or two increasing N+ striations with independently closed children and one optional final fixed P/T box explicitly located by the pinned export annotation.

known_blockers: ambiguous, missing or inconsistent P/T-box placement
more than two or malformed symbols
arbitrary text-changing, merged or granted symbol layouts
aggregate Station Cards coverage remains incomplete
